tool_args.rationale: The long-horizon measurements establish a transition from positive to negative gain, as predicted by dual-horizon adaptation. Numerically fit both amplitudes and timescales and test this stationary mechanism on fresh observations.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observed s_grad values are zero, so its gradient effect is unidentifiable; the simpler recalled dual-horizon model is supported by the reversal and can be tested by fresh confirmation.
The observations show sustained slow reversal after short-window growth, consistent with adaptation rather than the recalled single-frequency harmonic mechanism.
The existing eight observations cover both short and target horizons and constrain the four-parameter candidate; confirmation is more informative now.
